decision: Repair the Local execution handoff against the current command-line sources before adding candidate code.
rationale: The prior runbook used nonexistent flags for both control construction and scoring-plan generation and asserted a missing runner even though the committed scoring plan already provides one. These errors would prevent or misroute the first Local qualification run.
next_executable_step: Local executes the parser-only acceptance harness at the delivered commit, restores one receipt-bound W0 source/GT triplet, and runs the corrected control builder command.
evidence_policy: Documentation repair removes execution ambiguity but is not software acceptance or native scientific qualification.
